title.narrative: European Palestinian Credit Guarantee Foundation (EPCGF) - EU Mandate

description.narrative: The overall goal of the Action is to contribute to the stabilization of the Palestinian economy, economic growth, welfare creation and an economy that works for the people. The purpose of the Action is to enlarge the sustainable offer and the use of demand oriented financial services for Palestinian MSMEs by providing incentives to local financial institutions to make increased use of the guarantees issued by EPCGF.
